updates.title: Purview Endpoint DLP: FTP and SFTP Transfer Monitoring Now Generally Available
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP can now monitor and enforce policies on sensitive data transfers over FTP and SFTP protocols, allowing organizations to block or audit file movements to external systems. This extends data loss prevention capabilities beyond cloud and local endpoints to cover traditional file transfer methods.

updates.title: CVE-2026-105590: Windows Active Directory Certificate Services Security Feature Bypass
updates.summary: An improper certificate validation flaw in AD Certificate Services allows authorized attackers to bypass security features over the network, potentially enabling unauthorized certificate issuance or manipulation. Organizations running AD CS should apply the available patch to prevent exploitation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-118148: Active Directory Domain Services Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An elevation of privilege vulnerability in Active Directory Domain Services was identified and updated with refined CVSS scoring and corrected technical details. Admins should review the updated advisory and apply patches to protect domain controllers from privilege escalation attacks.

updates.title: CVE-2026-96082: Windows Kerberos Denial of Service Vulnerability
updates.summary: A denial of service vulnerability in Windows Kerberos authentication could allow attackers to disrupt authentication services. Organizations should monitor for available patches and apply them to prevent service outages.

updates.title: CVE-2026-121680: Windows NTLM Spoofing Vulnerability
updates.summary: A spoofing vulnerability in NTLM authentication allows attackers to impersonate legitimate users or systems on the network. This advisory has been updated to include Microsoft Office as affected software, widening the attack surface.

updates.title: Purview Data Loss Prevention Extends to Non-Microsoft Cloud Applications
updates.summary: DLP and auto-labeling capabilities now extend beyond Microsoft products to cover Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, AWS, and Cisco Webex. This allows organizations to enforce consistent data protection policies across their entire SaaS ecosystem.

updates.title: Purview Information Protection: Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
updates.summary: Administrators can now apply sensitivity labels directly to Entra cloud security groups, automatically inheriting classification and governance settings without requiring separate configuration. This simplifies compliance management for identity-based resources.

updates.title: Purview Adaptive Scope: Lifecycle State Evaluation Control
updates.summary: Administrators gain explicit control over how Adaptive Scopes evaluate recipient and site owner lifecycle status, ensuring policy targeting remains aligned with employee lifecycle events. This improves accuracy of scope membership for policies affecting dynamic user populations.

updates.title: Purview Endpoint DLP: Protect AI Agent Interactions with Expanded Local Agent Controls
updates.summary: DLP protection now extends to local AI agents, covering prompts, files, and tool interactions to prevent sensitive data exposure as agents access enterprise systems. This addresses security risks from autonomous AI systems operating on behalf of users.

updates.title: Purview Endpoint DLP: Network Layer Protection via Azure Firewall Integration
updates.summary: DLP extends to the network layer through Azure Firewall integration, enabling detection and enforcement of sensitive data policies on network traffic from servers, VMs, and automated workloads. This prevents unauthorized cloud application access through APIs and background services.

updates.title: Purview Insider Risk Management: Alert Classification System
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now supports alert classification as True Positive, Benign (Operational), or False Positive with predefined reasons, replacing legacy dismissal mechanisms. This feature enables more granular risk reporting and policy tuning to reduce alert fatigue.

updates.title: Purview Information Protection: Improved Sensitive Information Types
updates.summary: Microsoft's out-of-the-box sensitive information types (SITs) have been enhanced to detect sensitive data with greater precision and reliability. This reduces false positives and false negatives in DLP and auto-labeling policies.

updates.title: Purview Information Protection: Recurring Classifier Refresh
updates.summary: On-Demand Classification is evolving into recurring classification refreshes that automatically re-evaluate existing content as business context and data sensitivity changes. This keeps classification metadata current without manual intervention.

updates.title: Purview Information Protection: Auto-Apply Default SharePoint Library Labels
updates.summary: SharePoint files at rest can now be automatically labeled based on the default sensitivity label configured on their document library, closing labeling gaps without requiring manual user action. This ensures consistent default protection across repositories.

updates.title: Purview Information Protection: Sensitivity Label Inheritance for Teams Meeting Artifacts
updates.summary: Teams meeting recordings, transcripts, and Loop notes automatically inherit the sensitivity label from the meeting itself, ensuring consistent protection without manual labeling. This simplifies governance of meeting-generated content.

updates.title: Purview Data Security Triage Agent: Sensitive Data Remediation via Teams
updates.summary: The Data Security Triage Agent now includes automated sensitive data remediation across SharePoint and OneDrive, enabling organizations to proactively identify and fix data exposure (SSNs, passwords, credit cards) at scale. This significantly reduces compliance risk by addressing data already at rest.

updates.title: Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Azure PST Import
updates.summary: Organizations can now import PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage directly into Exchange Online mailboxes using the Exchange Migration Service. This modernizes legacy PST import workflows for cloud-native mail migrations.
